new_negative_evidence.finding: The retained 468-row factorial v3 donor has a critical P1 display-order nuisance leak because deterministic order selection includes the hidden base class; a nuisance-only lookup reached 127/144 = 0.8819444444 versus 0.3333333333 chance.
new_negative_evidence.consequence: Do not materialize or train directly from that v3 corpus until order is fully crossed or conditionally independent and nuisance-only plus semantic-ablation gates pass.

impact_on_variable_n_v4_fusion.reason: The v4 source design independently specifies all six display orders for every fixed architecture family x base semantic class x query polarity x realized S3 mapping x N cell, so it does not reuse the hidden-label-seeded stable-shuffle mechanism that caused the v3 leak.
impact_on_variable_n_v4_fusion.remaining_gap: The v4 local selftest established exact factorial crossing and zero marginal MI for class/N/polarity/family to target, but did not yet execute an explicit nuisance-only challenger or semantic-scene ablation challenger over final serialized model-visible rows.
required_before_any_materialization: nuisance-only decoder at preregistered chance/null bound
semantic-scene masking/ablation causing target/base-class prediction from nuisance features to fall to chance
display-order counterfactual twins preserving semantic scene, realized mapping and target across all six orders
checkpoint-local atom/tokenizer admission and immutable split-specific atom pools

research_return.new_training_rule: Pseudo-randomization is not independence. Every nuisance variable used in training data must be validated on the realized joint distribution and attacked by a nuisance-only decoder.
research_return.new_harness_rule: Binder evaluation must include semantic ablation and nuisance-only prediction alongside task accuracy, codebook flips, display-order invariance and variable-N invariance.
research_return.current_next_exact_action: Patch/select one single successor binder generator with full display-order crossing, then run nuisance-only and semantic-ablation regressions before checkpoint-local ABI materialization. Only after those pass should the variable-N architecture families be rendered with exact split-frozen atoms.
